company.title: One of their biggest strengths is the MPC-CMP technology. Instead of keeping private keys in one pla
company.description:
One of their biggest strengths is the MPC-CMP technology. Instead of keeping private keys in one place (which creates a dangerous single point of failure that hackers love to target), Fireblocks splits the key across multiple independent parties and devices. 

No single breach can steal the funds. Their upgraded MPC-CMP version even signs transactions super fast - in just one round, while still letting institutions keep some keys offline for extra security. 

It’s built for banks that can’t afford mistakes.

company.title: Anchorage Digital – ngân hàng crypto được cấp phép liên bang đầu tiên của Mỹ – vừa chính thức hỗ trợ
company.description:
Anchorage Digital – ngân hàng crypto được cấp phép liên bang đầu tiên của Mỹ – vừa chính thức hỗ trợ custody (lưu ký) TRX và staking trên mạng Tron. 

Đây là lần đầu tiên một công ty Mỹ được ủy quyền liên bang đưa toàn bộ mạng Tron “vào trong ranh giới quy định” (inside the regulatory perimeter) của Hoa Kỳ.

Điểm nổi bật:

- Anchorage hỗ trợ lưu ký $TRX trên nền tảng chính và ví tổ chức Porto, đồng thời sẽ triển khai dần các token TRC-20 (bao gồm USDT trên Tron – hiện có 84 tỷ USD).
- Điều này giúp các tổ chức tài chính Mỹ (hedge fund, treasury…) có thể tiếp cận Tron một cách an toàn, hợp quy mà trước đây gần như không thể do lo ngại quy định.
- @justinsuntron  và Nathan McCauley (CEO Anchorage) đều phát biểu tích cực, coi đây là bước quan trọng giúp mở rộng tiếp cận tổ chức cho hệ sinh thái Tron.

Ý nghĩa:Đây là cột mốc quy định lớn cho @trondao , giúp giảm rào cản và mở đường cho dòng vốn tổ chức Mỹ chảy vào mạng Tron (một trong những blockchain có USDT lớn nhất thế giới).Tin này khá bullish vì lần đầu tiên Tron được một ngân hàng liên bang Mỹ chính thức công nhận và hỗ trợ hạ tầng.

company.description:
🌞 ANCHORAGE BRINGS TRON “INSIDE THE REGULATORY PERIMETER”

This is a defining moment.

Not just access —
but recognition within regulated financial infrastructure.

1️⃣ WHAT THIS ACTUALLY MEANS

Anchorage Digital becoming the first federally chartered U.S. firm to support TRON DAO effectively places TRON:

➜ within a regulated custody framework
➜ inside institutional compliance boundaries
➜ accessible through federally supervised infrastructure

This is what “inside the regulatory perimeter” really signals:

from external asset → recognized financial instrument

2️⃣ WHY THIS IS A MAJOR UNLOCK
Institutions require:

➜ regulatory clarity
➜ qualified custody providers
➜ compliant operational pathways

With Anchorage:

➜ TRX can be held under regulated custody
➜ mandates can be executed legally
➜ internal risk frameworks can approve exposure

This removes the biggest barrier:

compliance risk

3️⃣ FROM ACCESS → ALLOCATION
Once an asset is inside the regulatory perimeter:
➜ it becomes eligible for institutional portfolios
➜ treasury allocations become viable
➜ capital can scale without structural friction

This shifts TRON from:

accessible → allocatable → scalable

4️⃣ STRATEGIC CONTEXT: THE INSTITUTIONAL STACK IS FORMING
We are seeing convergence across:

➜ custody (Anchorage)
➜ network infrastructure (TRON)
➜ capital (institutions)

This creates a new pipeline:

regulated entry → on-chain participation → capital deployment

5️⃣ WHAT COMES NEXT

With custody established, next layers follow:

➜ TRC-20 asset support
➜ staking integration
➜ DeFi participation within compliance frameworks
➜ structured financial products
Custody is step one.
Capital flow is step two.

6️⃣ FINAL NOTE

Being inside the regulatory perimeter is not just symbolic.

It is structural.

It means TRON is no longer operating at the edge of finance —
but increasingly within its core framework.

And when that happens,
adoption is no longer optional.

It becomes inevitable.
@justinsuntron #TRONEcoStar
@trondao

🌞 ANCHORAGE DIGITAL: THE INSTITUTIONAL GATEWAY INTO TRON

This is where access becomes scalable.

Not just wallets.
Not just exchanges.
But regulated infrastructure for institutional capital.

1️⃣ WHAT’S LIVE: TRX CUSTODY

Anchorage Digital now supports custody for TRX on the TRON DAO network.

This enables:

➜ secure, compliant asset storage
➜ institutional onboarding pathways
➜ operational readiness for funds and enterprises

Custody is the first requirement.

Without it, institutions don’t participate

2️⃣ WHAT’S NEXT: EXPANDING CAPABILITIES
The roadmap is already clear:

➜ TRC-20 asset support
➜ native TRX staking (coming soon)

This evolves the integration from:

holding → participating → earning
Institutions will not just store TRX.

They will:

➜ interact with on-chain assets
➜ deploy capital into yield
➜ engage with the TRON ecosystem directly

3️⃣ WHY THIS IS A STRUCTURAL SHIFT

This integration connects three layers:

➜ custody (Anchorage Digital)
➜ network (TRON DAO)
➜ capital (institutions)

When these align:

➜ compliance barriers drop
➜ capital allocation becomes viable
➜ ecosystem credibility increases

This is how networks move from:
accessible → allocatable

4️⃣ THE ROLE OF STAKING

Native TRX staking will be a key unlock:

➜ introduces yield within a regulated framework
➜ aligns institutional capital with network security
➜ supports long-term holding strategies

TRX becomes:

a productive asset, not just a stored one

5️⃣ STRATEGIC CONTEXT: INSTITUTIONAL DEFI IS FORMING
The direction is clear:

➜ custody providers expanding capabilities
➜ institutions entering on-chain ecosystems
➜ yield opportunities becoming regulated

By integrating with Anchorage Digital, TRON positions itself within this emerging structure.

 FINAL NOTE
Access defines participation.
Participation drives capital.
Capital scales ecosystems.

With custody live and staking on the way,
TRON is not just part of the conversation —
it is becoming institution-ready infrastructure.

In the evolving world of digital finance, the battle for institutional trust is as crucial as network speed or user adoption. Today, Anchorage Digital—America’s first federally chartered crypto bank—takes a decisive step in that battle by embracing the TRON Network. This isn’t just an announcement; it’s a statement: TRON is no longer just a high-throughput blockchain favored by retail users and stablecoin transfers—it is now ready for the scrutiny, rigor, and capital of institutional players.

By integrating TRON, Anchorage is opening the door for regulated, institutional-grade custody of TRX, turning a widely used network into a bridge between traditional finance and the decentralized future.

▪️Institutional-Grade Validation for TRON

Anchorage Digital operates under a U.S. federal charter, placing it within a strict compliance and regulatory perimeter. By extending support to TRON, it effectively signals that the network meets a threshold of operational reliability, security architecture, and market relevance required for institutional participation.

For asset managers, hedge funds, and fintech platforms, this means:
➜ Qualified Custody: TRON assets can now be held by a regulated, trusted institution
➜ Regulatory Clarity: Institutional compliance risk is dramatically reduced
➜ Operational Confidence: Governance, security, and execution now meet professional standards

▪️Secure Custody for TRX

With this integration, institutions can securely store TRX on Anchorage’s regulated platform, gaining:
➜ Regulated Safekeeping: Compliance-backed custody within a federally chartered framework
➜ Advanced Security Architecture: Multi-layer hardware and governance protections
➜ Operational Efficiency: Simplified management of TRX exposure without fragmented systems
